title: Verify capabilities
description: The capabilities blob of VerifyRuntimeDiagnostics: what a submitter can know before a run. It takes no taskset. Nodes run the same module as the host (the platform admits no other version to the work), so the runtimes listed are the pool's.

wasmtime.description: The engine the sandbox runs on: the version of the wasmtime .NET binding and of the native library under it, e.g. "48.0.2.0 (native 48.0.8)". A native library that is not one the controller ships is "unpinned" with the start of its SHA-256.

benchmark_unit.description: The unit of the pool's rate: tasks of the reference workload per second.

id.description: The runtime id a task names.

sha256.description: The pinned hash of the runtime module; empty for the raw wasi runtime, whose module comes with each task.

available.description: The module is present and passed its hash pin in the host's copy of the controller.

defaults.description: What applies when the options and the task leave a value unset.

ceilings.description: The most a task may ask for; a larger request is clamped when the taskset is split.

packages.description: How a run is cut into the blobs nodes download: one batch per package while the run is small, about `target` packages once it is large.

pool.description: The nodes that can take Verify work for this submitter now, as totals; absent when the host cannot say. No node is named.

measured.description: Nodes that have measured themselves on the reference workload; the next two numbers are theirs.

workers.description: Concurrent sandboxes of the measured nodes, added up. Absent when the host does not carry the degree of every measured node.

rate.description: Reference tasks per second, added up. Real tasks are faster or slower than the reference ones.
